title: smime-tree verify(): signedAttrs-absent path rejected silently — needs public doc note
description: smime-tree/src/verify.rs:173 — When signedAttrs is absent, the code returns a failure. RFC 5652 §5.4 allows bare-content signatures (no signedAttrs). This is a documented limitation in AGENTS/CLAUDE.md but it is not documented in the public-facing verify() doc comment. Fix: add a note to the verify() doc comment that SignerInfo structs without signedAttrs are always rejected, and cross-reference RFC 5652 §5.4.
close_reason: Already documented in verify() # Limitations section at lines 59-64
